shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣穿隔离衣、戴手套和护目镜站在生物实验室门口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears an isolation gown, gloves and goggles at a biology lab door and greets the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲生物实验个人防护装备。
overlay: 生物实验个人防护装备

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰穿便服、只戴一副手套走向核酸提取仪
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in street clothes, wearing only gloves, walks toward an extraction instrument.
shots.narration: 阿杰只戴了手套，就要上机提核酸。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指向防护用品柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to a cabinet of protective equipment.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：实验服、护目镜呢？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰挠头：到底该穿哪些？
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking at gowns, masks and goggles with a question mark.
shots.narration: 阿杰犯难：到底该穿哪些？

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 设施、规程、个人防护三层盾，最外是个人防护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three shields in layers for facility, procedure and personal protection, the last one closest to the person. No text.
shots.narration: 设施规程在前，个人防护是最后一道。
overlay: 个人防护是最后一道防线

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 安全柜旁的人仍戴手套、穿实验服
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person working at a biosafety cabinet still wears gloves and a lab gown. No text.
shots.narration: 有了安全柜，防护用品照样要戴。

shots.section_title: 个人防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 防护用品戴歪，箭头穿过缺口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loose mask and an open gown cuff with an arrow slipping through the gap. No text.
shots.narration: 用得对，才能真正挡住风险。

shots.section_title: 按风险评估选，写进规程
shots.scene: 风险评估表连着一排防护用品
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a risk assessment form linked to a row of protective items. No text.
shots.narration: 穿哪些，不凭感觉，按风险评估。
overlay: 按风险评估选，写进规程

shots.section_title: 按风险评估选，写进规程
shots.scene: 防护用品越堆越多，打叉；自行减掉，也打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person piled with extra gear crossed out, and a person removing required gear also crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不是越多越好，也别自作主张加减。

shots.section_title: 按风险评估选，写进规程
shots.scene: 评估结果写进实验室规程，大家照做
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: assessment results written into the lab procedure book, with several workers following it. No text.
shots.narration: 评估结果写进规程，人人照做。

shots.section_title: 按风险评估选，写进规程
shots.scene: 旧海报打问号，新规定和说明书打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an old poster with a question mark beside a current regulation book and instruction sheet with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 疫情时期的做法，以现行规定为准。

shots.section_title: 按风险评估选，写进规程
shots.scene: 新用品试用，小研记下问题反馈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tries a new gown and notes a problem on a feedback form.
shots.narration: 新用品先试，用着有问题及时反馈。

shots.section_title: 三看：病原类别、侵入途径、具体操作
shots.scene: 三个放大镜：病原、途径、操作
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three magnifying glasses over a microbe icon, a body entry icon and a pipette icon. No text.
shots.narration: 选防护三看：病原、途径、操作。
overlay: 三看：病原类别、侵入途径、具体操作

shots.section_title: 三看：病原类别、侵入途径、具体操作
shots.scene: 病原分类阶梯，第一类在顶端
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a staircase of pathogen categories with the highest hazard at the top and stronger protection beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 一看病原：国内第一类危害最高。

shots.section_title: 三看：病原类别、侵入途径、具体操作
shots.scene: 不明病原问号，指向最高一级防护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unknown microbe with a question mark pointing to the strongest protection level. No text.
shots.narration: 不明病原先从严，最终由评估定。

shots.section_title: 三看：病原类别、侵入途径、具体操作
shots.scene: 口鼻、眼睛、皮肤、针刺四个入口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: entry routes into the body: breathing, eyes, skin and a needle prick. No text.
shots.narration: 二看途径：从哪里进，就挡哪里。

shots.section_title: 三看：病原类别、侵入途径、具体操作
shots.scene: 接收样本基本防护，提取离心加强防护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sample receiving with basic gear, then extraction and centrifuging with added mask and goggles. No text.
shots.narration: 三看操作：产生气溶胶的要加强。

shots.section_title: 从头到脚，不留缺口
shots.scene: 从头到脚一套：头套、护目镜、口罩、隔离衣、手套、鞋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: head-to-toe protective set: cap, goggles, mask, gown, gloves and closed shoes. No text.
shots.narration: 从头到脚认一认，全套防护。

shots.section_title: 从头到脚，不留缺口
shots.scene: 五类图标：口罩、手套、防护服、护目、特殊防护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: five icons for masks, gloves, protective clothing, eye protection and special equipment. No text.
shots.narration: 口罩、手套、防护服、护目、特殊防护。

shots.section_title: 从头到脚，不留缺口
shots.scene: 手腕露出一截皮肤，红圈标注
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a strip of bare wrist between glove and sleeve circled in red. No text.
shots.narration: 哪里露着皮肤，哪里就是缺口。

shots.section_title: 从头到脚，不留缺口
shots.scene: 【实拍】手套翻边盖住实验服袖口（训练用服装）
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pulls the glove cuff over the lab coat sleeve.
shots.narration: 手套要盖住袖口。

shots.section_title: 从头到脚，不留缺口
shots.scene: 便服加一副手套上机打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in street clothes with only gloves at an instrument, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只戴手套穿便服上机，不行。

shots.section_title: 手套：生物材料可戴两层
shots.scene: 乳胶和腈手套两只，溶剂滴落
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a latex glove and a nitrile glove side by side with solvent drops, each with a limit icon. No text.
shots.narration: 乳胶挡不住很多溶剂，腈也有局限。
overlay: 手套：生物材料可戴两层

shots.section_title: 手套：生物材料可戴两层
shots.scene: 两层手套，外层沾污，内层完好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: double gloves where the outer glove is stained and the inner glove stays clean. No text.
shots.narration: 处理生物材料可戴两层，外脏内护。

shots.section_title: 手套：生物材料可戴两层
shots.scene: 外层污染了就换外层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stained outer glove peeled off and replaced while the inner glove stays on. No text.
shots.narration: 外层污染了，及时换外层。

shots.section_title: 手套：生物材料可戴两层
shots.scene: 抓动物戴加厚防咬手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick bite-resistant glove holding a lab mouse. No text.
shots.narration: 抓动物戴加厚手套，防咬防抓。

shots.section_title: 隔离衣与防护服：挡飞溅，不出门
shots.scene: 隔离衣挡住小飞溅
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small splashes stopped by an isolation gown. No text.
shots.narration: 隔离衣、防护服挡小飞溅。
overlay: 隔离衣与防护服：挡飞溅，不出门

shots.section_title: 隔离衣与防护服：挡飞溅，不出门
shots.scene: 大量液体浸透防护服，警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large spill soaking through the gown with a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 大量溢洒挡不住，浸湿了要立即更换。

shots.section_title: 隔离衣与防护服：挡飞溅，不出门
shots.scene: 医用一次性防护服，标签上有标准图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a disposable medical protective coverall with a blank standard label and a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 医用防护服要符合国家标准。

shots.section_title: 隔离衣与防护服：挡飞溅，不出门
shots.scene: 穿防护服走出实验室门，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in a protective gown walking out of the lab into a corridor, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 防护服不出实验室。

shots.section_title: 医用口罩与医用防护口罩
shots.scene: 气溶胶飘向口鼻，口罩挡住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: aerosol drifting toward the nose and mouth, stopped by a mask. No text.
shots.narration: 经气溶胶吸入的病原，要靠口罩挡。
overlay: 医用口罩与医用防护口罩

shots.section_title: 医用口罩与医用防护口罩
shots.scene: 医用外科口罩和医用防护口罩对比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flat surgical mask beside a cup-shaped medical protective respirator, each with a different shield icon. No text.
shots.narration: 医用口罩防飞溅，防护口罩防气溶胶。

shots.section_title: 医用口罩与医用防护口罩
shots.scene: 外形相似的两只口罩，一只挡液体一只不挡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two similar masks, one blocking a liquid splash, the other letting it through. No text.
shots.narration: 长得像，用途不同，看清说明。

shots.section_title: 医用口罩与医用防护口罩
shots.scene: 评估表指向选哪种口罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a risk assessment form with an arrow choosing between the two mask types. No text.
shots.narration: 用哪种口罩，由风险评估定。

shots.section_title: 医用口罩与医用防护口罩
shots.scene: 防护口罩做适合性检验
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fit test hood over a person wearing a protective respirator. No text.
shots.narration: 防护口罩选好后，要做适合性检验。

shots.section_title: 医用口罩与医用防护口罩
shots.scene: 口罩喷消毒剂打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mask being sprayed with disinfectant for reuse, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 消毒会损坏口罩，不要重复使用。

shots.section_title: 护目镜、面屏、口罩各管一处
shots.scene: 护目镜护眼，面屏挡脸前飞溅
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: goggles sealing the eyes and a face shield blocking splashes in front of the face. No text.
shots.narration: 护目镜护眼睛，面屏挡脸前飞溅。
overlay: 护目镜、面屏、口罩各管一处

shots.section_title: 护目镜、面屏、口罩各管一处
shots.scene: 面屏下气溶胶仍被吸入，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: aerosol drifting under a face shield into the nose, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 面屏不防吸入，不能代替口罩。

shots.section_title: 护目镜、面屏、口罩各管一处
shots.scene: 可重复使用的护目镜按规程消毒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: reusable goggles wiped with disinfectant and dried on a rack. No text.
shots.narration: 可重复用的，按规程消毒后再用。

shots.section_title: 送风头罩和正压防护服
shots.scene: 送风头罩只罩住头面部
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a powered air hood covering only the head and face, with gown and gloves added separately. No text.
shots.narration: 送风头罩只护呼吸和头面。
overlay: 送风头罩和正压防护服

shots.section_title: 送风头罩和正压防护服
shots.scene: 头罩之外，防护服手套照样配齐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in an air hood also wearing a protective gown and gloves, checked. No text.
shots.narration: 防护服、手套一样不能少。

shots.section_title: 送风头罩和正压防护服
shots.scene: 正压防护服破口，空气向外流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a positive pressure suit with a small tear where air flows outward. No text.
shots.narration: 最高等级实验室穿正压防护服。

shots.section_title: 送风头罩和正压防护服
shots.scene: 正压服旁有培训证书和专人图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a positive pressure suit beside a training certificate and a supervisor icon. No text.
shots.narration: 高级别防护，须专门培训才能用。

shots.section_title: 临床与诊断实验的常见防护组合
shots.scene: 临床实验室常规：实验服或隔离衣、手套、护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clinical lab worker with a gown, gloves and goggles handling sealed sample tubes. No text.
shots.narration: 临床检验常规：隔离衣、手套、护目镜。
overlay: 临床与诊断实验的常见防护组合

shots.section_title: 临床与诊断实验的常见防护组合
shots.scene: 呼吸道传染病样本：防护口罩、护目镜或面屏、防护服、双层手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker in a protective respirator, face shield, coverall and double gloves at a biosafety cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 呼吸道样本：防护口罩、护目、双层手套。

shots.section_title: 临床与诊断实验的常见防护组合
shots.scene: 现行规定书和评估表并列
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a current regulation book beside a risk assessment form. No text.
shots.narration: 具体组合，按现行规定和评估定。

shots.section_title: 合格产品，配齐尺码，用前检查
shots.scene: 防护用品包装上的标准号图标，统一采购入库
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: protective items with blank standard labels being received and logged into a store room. No text.
shots.narration: 买合格产品，统一采购，登记入库。
overlay: 合格产品，配齐尺码，用前检查

shots.section_title: 合格产品，配齐尺码，用前检查
shots.scene: 手套、隔离衣按尺码排开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gloves and gowns arranged in several sizes on a shelf. No text.
shots.narration: 按人配齐，大小尺码都要有。

shots.section_title: 合格产品，配齐尺码，用前检查
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴前检查手套：吹气或对光查看有无破口（训练用手套）
shots.prompt_en: Hands check a new glove for holes by gently trapping air and looking against the light.
shots.narration: 戴前检查，破损马上换。

shots.section_title: 合格产品，配齐尺码，用前检查
shots.scene: 日历上的有效期，过期打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a package with an expiry calendar icon; an expired package crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 看清有效期，过期不用，快用完就补。

shots.section_title: 一次性不重复用，破损要报告
shots.scene: 用过的手套和防护服丢进感染性废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used gloves and a disposable gown dropped into a biohazard bag. No text.
shots.narration: 一次性用品用过就丢，不挂起来再穿。
overlay: 一次性不重复用，破损要报告

shots.section_title: 一次性不重复用，破损要报告
shots.scene: 用后废物袋送去灭菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the biohazard bag carried to an autoclave. No text.
shots.narration: 按感染性废物，灭菌后处置。

shots.section_title: 一次性不重复用，破损要报告
shots.scene: 防护服破口，小研记录上报
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student finds a tear in her gown and reports it to the older man with a record sheet.
shots.narration: 防护服破了，记录上报，定期检查。

shots.section_title: 防护离不开管理：评估、培训、规程
shots.scene: 评估、选择、培训、规程四步阶梯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four steps for assessment, selection, training and procedure. No text.
shots.narration: 先评估，再选择，再培训，照规程。
overlay: 防护离不开管理：评估、培训、规程

shots.section_title: 防护离不开管理：评估、培训、规程
shots.scene: 王老师带学生练习穿脱
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator coaches the young male student practicing putting on a gown.
shots.narration: 穿和脱都要培训，按规程一步步来。

shots.section_title: 防护离不开管理：评估、培训、规程
shots.scene: 头发束起、首饰摘下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: long hair tied back and jewelry removed before gearing up. No text.
shots.narration: 头发束好，首饰摘掉，再穿防护。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 三看：病原、途径、操作
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three magnifying glasses over a microbe, an entry route and a pipette. No text.
shots.narration: 按评估选：看病原、看途径、看操作。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 手套、隔离衣、口罩、护目镜各就各位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gloves, gown, mask and goggles each covering its own body part. No text.
shots.narration: 手套两层，衣服盖严，口罩护目各管一处。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 合格、检查、不重复、报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons for a certified product, an inspection, a no-reuse sign and a report. No text.
shots.narration: 合格不过期，用前检查，用后不重复。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣拿着隔离衣，准备穿戴
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an isolation gown, ready to put it on, and waves.
shots.narration: 下一课：防护装备的穿戴与脱卸。
